title: Mirabel and the House
author: Xanthe Underhill
blurb: Wren Vasquez, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
